12:     tau_filter: float,
13: ) -> tuple[np.ndarray, np.ndarray]:
14:     """Return an ordered keep mask and one finite margin per proposed call."""
15: 
16:     # Validate inputs
17:     if isinstance(tau_filter, bool):
18:         raise ValueError("tau_filter cannot be a boolean")
19:     if not np.isscalar(tau_filter):
20:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be a scalar")
21:     if not np.isfinite(tau_filter):
22:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be finite")
23:     if tau_filter < 0:
24:         raise ValueError("tau_filter must be nonnegative")
25: 
26:     for arr, name in [(logp_with_result, 'logp_with_result'), (logp_call_only, 'logp_call_only'), (logp_no_call, 'logp_no_call')]:
27:         if not isinstance(arr, np.ndarray):
28:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a numpy array")
29:         if arr.ndim != 2:
30:             raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a 2D matrix")
31:         if not np.all(np.isfinite(arr)):
32:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains non-finite values")
33:         if np.any(arr > 0):
34:             raise ValueError(f"{name} contains positive values")
35: 
36:     if not (logp_with_result.shape == logp_call_only.shape == logp_no_call.shape):
37:         raise ValueError("All input matrices must have the same shape")
38: 
39:     n_candidates, horizon = logp_with_result.shape
40: 
41:     # Normalize weights
42:     t = np.arange(horizon, dtype=float)
43:     raw_weights = np.maximum(0.0, 1.0 - 0.2 * t)
44:     if raw_weights.sum() == 0:
45:         norm_weights = np.ones(horizon) / horizon if horizon > 0 else np.array([])
46:     else:
47:         norm_weights = raw_weights / raw_weights.sum()
48: 
49:     # Compute weighted losses (lower is better)
50:     L_plus = -np.dot(logp_with_result, norm_weights)
51:     L_call_only = -np.dot(logp_call_only, norm_weights)
52:     L_empty = -np.dot(logp_no_call, norm_weights)
53: 
54:     L_minus = np.minimum(L_empty, L_call_only)
55:     margins = L_minus - L_plus
56:     keep_mask = margins >= tau_filter
